title: Kubb Extension Manifest
description: The kubb-extension.json file at the root of a Kubb plugin, adapter, or parser package. It ships with the package on npm or GitHub, and the Kubb extension registry, the Kubb CLI, and Kubb Studio read it. Readers ignore unknown top-level keys.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema for editor validation.

export.description: The factory export users call in kubb.config.ts, e.g. 'pluginZod'.

description.description: One sentence on what the extension does.

category.description: Category for organization and filtering, e.g. 'validation'.

dark.description: Icon for dark mode. Falls back to light when omitted.

media.description: Screenshots or videos, as HTTPS URLs.

maintainers.description: People who maintain the extension, shown on its kubb.dev page.

dependencies.description: Names of the extensions that must be in the same config, e.g. ['plugin-ts'].

optionalDependencies.description: Names of the extensions the extension works with when they are in the same config, e.g. ['plugin-zod'].

compatibility.description: Version ranges the extension supports. Only these two keys are allowed, so a typo cannot skip a check.

role.description: Plugins only. 'client' provides the HTTP client runtime, 'consumer' calls one but ships none.

options.description: Form fields Kubb Studio renders. Each field edits the value at `path` inside the options object passed to the factory.

key.description: Stable UI key, unique within the manifest, e.g. 'enumType'.

path.description: Where the value lives in the options object, e.g. ['enum', 'type'].

description.description: Help text shown under the field.

default.description: The plugin's runtime default, shown when unset. A value equal to it is not written.

choices.description: Select only. A choice with value null means 'leave unset'.

trueValue.description: Boolean only. Value written for true. Defaults to true.

falseValue.description: Boolean only. Value written for false. Defaults to false.

item.description: List only. Template for each entry, where every string '$item' is replaced by the entry. Without it, entries are plain strings.

itemCase.description: List only. Upper-case each entry before writing.
